title: Expert Iteration: Experiments and Lessons
contribution_type: pedagogical research archive and bounded empirical lessons
predecessor_credit: Established expert-iteration and MCTS methods; queelius/reductio state-core predecessor by the same author; Qwen/Alibaba Cloud worker models, OpenAI coordinator, Hugging Face and Featherless inference infrastructure; OpenAI GSM8K and Dan Hendrycks MATH benchmark notices retained for historical material.
ai_assistance: Substantial assistance in code, experiments, analysis, separate AI review, writing, and publication preparation. AI review is not human peer review.
claim: A reproducible teaching and evidence archive recounts eight selected descriptive comparisons. E20 direct/imitated-controller outcomes were 8/20 versus 0/20. On 60 reused saved problems E41 independent revision supplied 55 correct candidates and E42 explicit routing solved 51; this was not cost matched. E47 child-local/full outcomes were 33/72 versus 24/72 within 12 source states, while the discovery-selected fixed child tied direct at 10/24 and target adaptation failed registered criteria.

public_disclosure.basis: Previously private source made public and README checked without authentication. Historical experiment and commit dates are private development dates, not a claimed prior disclosure.

scientific_status.correctness: Reconstruction of saved record-level outcomes plus tested classical demonstration
scientific_status.novelty: not established; no novel successful method claimed

verification.network_control: Python socket audit hook; not an OS-level sandbox
verification.fresh_ai_review: No important archive/publication defects found; publication sequencing was verified.

publication.github_archival_note: Archival follows the final owning-project receipt commit; verify before final index publication.

license.third_party: Model and benchmark notices in the packet's NOTICE and LICENSES; no worker model weights redistributed.

limitations: Recorded correctness labels are recounted, not independently symbolically rechecked.
Reused outputs, small samples, development-state reuse, and unequal call budgets limit interpretation.
E47 repeated cells are grouped within 12 states; no new significance claim is introduced.
Three historical symbolic-replay checks exceeded 120-second limits; the full historical suite is not certified green.
The planned full off-policy RL and search-efficiency comparison was not completed.
No general controller impossibility, decomposition advantage, algorithmic novelty, peer review, or priority is established.
